source: Qur'oni Karim (Moida surasi, 6-oyat) / Bulugh al-Maram (Tahorat bobi)
title: Tahorat
text:
The 4 obligatory steps (Fard) of Wudu from Quran (5:6):
1. Washing the face once completely.
2. Washing both arms up to and including the elbows.
3. Wiping over a portion of the head.
4. Washing both feet up to and including the ankles.

source: Riyozus Solihiyn / Sahihi Buxoriy va Muslim (Sahih hadislar)
title: Namoz
text:
The 5 daily obligatory prayers:
- Fajr: 2 Sunnah, 2 Fard.
- Dhuhr: 4 Sunnah, 4 Fard, 2 Sunnah.
- Asr: 4 Fard.
- Maghrib: 3 Fard, 2 Sunnah.
- Isha: 4 Fard, 2 Sunnah, 3 Witr.
